sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
LINTEC Corporation is a comprehensive manufacturer of adhesive-related products and specialty papers founded in 1927 that offers products to various industries with an overseas ratio of over 60%.

Industry: Manufacturing · HQ: Japan · Size: $1B+ · Products: Adhesive papers and films, Barcode label supplies, Digital label printing machines, Industrial-use adhesive tapes, Automobile-use adhesive products, Barcode printers

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: LINTEC Corporation scores 20 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by company size (15/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on chemical resistance, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (44% similar on films, specialty, printing, tapes); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (43% similar on films, window, color, digital); ORAFOL Europe (38% similar on films, printing, adhesive, pdf). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
